title: Restaurant or café design: where should an owner start
seo_title: Restaurant Interior Design: Where to Start
description: Restaurant and café interior design step by step: concept, dining room and kitchen layout, lighting, materials, 3D and budget — a guide from a Kyiv studio.
lead: A venue's interior is not decoration — it is a sales tool. It affects the number of covers, how fast staff can work and whether guests want to come back. Here is where to start with restaurant or café design.
photo_alt: Sofas, candles and woven pendants under a timber ceiling — Yacht Restaurant interior design
body: First define who your guest is, the average bill, the cuisine and the format: quick café, restaurant or bar. Everything depends on this — seating density, lighting, music, materials. A place for a quick lunch and a restaurant for long dinners need completely different solutions, even on the same floor area.

Put the concept into a few sentences: who the venue is for, what people eat there, the atmosphere and how it differs from its neighbours on the street. That becomes the reference point for the designer, the chef and marketing.
Think also about how the venue will work through the day: breakfasts, business lunches, dinners, the bar. Each scenario affects seating, lighting and music, and the design has to handle them all.
number of covers and a mix of seating: tables for two, groups, the bar
short waiter routes between kitchen and dining room
separate routes for deliveries and waste, so they never cross guests

We design the kitchen together with a kitchen consultant or the chef: equipment positions determine ventilation, drainage and electrics. If you draw a beautiful dining room first and squeeze the kitchen in later, rework is almost guaranteed.

How guests see the venue matters too: where they are greeted, where the eye falls from the doorway, whether there are window seats people want to take. The most popular tables are the ones with a view and a sense of privacy, so plan as many of them as possible.
Restaurant dining room with round tables under arches and a timber ceiling — Yacht Restaurant design project

Lighting sets the mood more strongly than any decor: day and evening scenes, accents on tables and the bar counter. Materials must be both beautiful and hard-wearing — a venue works every day, and chairs, floors and tabletops take a load they never would at home.
flooring that withstands wet cleaning and heels
fabrics and upholstery that are easy to clean
tabletops resistant to heat, alcohol and stains
acoustic solutions so people can talk comfortably
Woven rattan pendants over the tables and a bar with shelving — Yacht Restaurant design project
Long restaurant table against a wine wall with a sculpture — Monpark restaurant project
Fireplace in a textured stone surround in a restaurant dining room — Yacht Restaurant design project

Visualisations let you see the venue before works start and change decisions while it costs nothing. 3D shows how the entrance reads from the street, whether the bar blocks the walkway and how the rooms will look in the evening.
Another benefit: visualisations help you prepare a presentation for partners and your first social media posts while the venue is still being built.

Drawings for the builders, furniture and lighting specifications, the estimate. Furniture, lighting and decor can be sourced directly from China, which noticeably lowers the opening budget. Orders should be placed right after the design is approved, so that [turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement) arrives by the end of the renovation.
The specification fixes every item: the chair model, fabric, light fitting, quantity. Materials cannot be swapped for cheaper alternatives, and you know exactly what you will get.

A venue design project at CAS Development costs from $30 per m², with a minimum project fee of $2,500. For a 120 m² café, for example, that is from $3,600 (120 × $30). We confirm the exact fee after the brief: it depends on the scope of the project and the number of rooms. Examples include Yacht Restaurant and Monpark in our portfolio.

Besides design, an opening budget includes the renovation, building services, kitchen equipment, furniture and decor. Count them together from the start, so you do not find at the end that there is no money left for furniture.
starting the renovation without a kitchen and services design
packing in as many seats as possible, so guests are uncomfortable and staff cannot keep up
leaving one general light with no evening scene
choosing home-grade materials that wear out in the first season
forgetting the signage, the entrance and how the venue looks from the street
Most of these mistakes only become visible after opening, when they have to be fixed in a working venue. That is why we fix every decision in the design before the renovation starts.
Checklist before you contact a designer
floor plan of the premises and information on building services
the menu, or at least a list of dishes, for kitchen planning
an indicative budget for design, renovation and procurement
With this information the first meeting goes straight to the point, and the designer can propose several layout options. The first meetings can be held online if you are not in Kyiv.

We take a venue from concept to opening — [turnkey design implementation](/en/design-implementation): interior design, working drawings, estimate, renovation by our own team and procurement. You have one manager and regular reports, and works carry a 36-month warranty. If CAS carries out the renovation, the final cost stays within ±5% of the estimate. We have completed 150+ projects since 2016, are based in Kyiv and work across Ukraine, in Europe and worldwide.
faq: What comes first — renovation or design?
Design: the layout determines the building services, furniture and number of covers.
Can you also renovate the venue?
Yes, with our own team. If CAS carries out the renovation, we keep the final cost within ±5% of the estimate, and furniture can be sourced directly from China.
How much does café or restaurant design cost?
From $30 per m², with a minimum project fee of $2,500. We confirm the exact fee after the brief.
Can the interior be updated without closing the venue for long?
Yes. Works can be split into stages and scheduled around opening hours; specific timelines are agreed after a site visit.
